necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
